title: Independent-universe Cech double-complex comparison
statement: For a site C with v-small morphisms, finite wide pullbacks and sheafification of v-small abelian presheaves, assume HasExt in universe v and EnoughInjectives for abelian sheaves. For an abelian sheaf F and a covering family indexed in universe v, there is a double complex of AddCommGrpCat.{v} whose column homology is the Cech complex of the cohomology presheaves of F and whose total homology is the sheaf cohomology of F.
